summary: Completed end-to-end testing of the new Audit Room / Share Link features on System Health admin console and the public audit-room portal. All admin UI testids are present and wired; Room Branding modal opens, saves welcome-note and returns success toast; Auditor Comments panel renders real seeded comments; Revoke-all button is present and wired; public audit-room HTML page renders all required sections and the /comment endpoint accepts JSON POSTs (verified via UI fill + backend curl).

minor.issue: Only accepts JSON body — form-encoded POST returns 422. The rendered public HTML uses JS (fetch) to POST JSON, which is fine; noting for future ref if anyone tries a plain <form method=POST> fallback.

critical_code_review_comments: Public audit-room portal (server-rendered HTML) uses <button id='csend'> + inline JS (fetch) instead of a native <form>. This works and shows a green 'Thank you' via JS DOM update, but note that automated tests need to click #csend rather than submitting a form. Consider also wrapping inputs in a <form onsubmit=...> so Enter-to-submit works and non-JS browsers still get a graceful failure.
The public /audit-room/{token}/comment endpoint accepts only application/json; if progressive-enhancement matters, also accept application/x-www-form-urlencoded.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 79 verified: (1) /app/system-health has sh-audit-room-create, sh-room-branding-btn, sh-revoke-all, sh-comments-panel (with sh-comment-0), sh-links-panel; (2) sh-brand-modal contains sh-brand-logo-input, sh-brand-use-org, sh-brand-welcome, sh-brand-save; save closes modal + 'Audit Room branding saved' toast; (3) Backend endpoints GET /api/deploy/audit-room-branding, PUT same, GET /api/deploy/audit-room-comments, POST /api/deploy/audit-room/{token}/comment all return 200; (4) Public HTML portal at /api/deploy/audit-room/{token} renders welcome note, KPI tiles including 'Open SoD violations' (8), 'Top open Segregation-of-Duties violations' table w/ severity/rule/area/holder, 'Latest signed evidence' section w/ download link, and 'Leave a comment' form (single input + textarea + JS-driven Submit button). Revoke-all button was NOT clicked to preserve the seeded audit room; only presence + wiring were verified.
